title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Woven Care Paths. Keep it, choose an alternate, or ask for another hand.

options.label: Woven Care Paths
options.thesis: Two care journeys interlace into one clear, dependable service.
options.viewport: A calm Care-Flash home shows one confident request action, the active visit, and a fine two-strand progress stitch; Care-Merchant carries the same weave grammar in a request-first work surface.
options.risk: Can feel like a craft store if weave marks spread beyond purposeful status paths.

raised.raise: Use crisp light-dark contrast for every task and status; no ornamental low-contrast field.
Keep each screen to its next useful decision and the information that supports it.
Make session duration and elapsed-time changes exact and legible, never decorative motion.
Give each screen one unmistakable primary action while keeping standard app navigation familiar.

options.label: The Clinic Visit Card
options.lineage: Puskesmas queue tickets and visit cards
options.thesis: Every visit reads like a thoughtful, trusted care record.
options.viewport: A clear personal welcome leads into a sharply prioritized booking card with visit reference, caregiver, status, and one next step; the same record structure serves caregiver requests and session handoffs.
options.risk: A familiar direction; without strong type and generous spacing it can look like a generic clinic form.

options.label: Transfer-Line Wayfinding
options.lineage: Midnight transit diagrams and Indonesian station signage
options.thesis: Follow a care request as a clear journey through its next station.
options.viewport: A standard app shell leads to the booking, with a route-like status path showing matching, arrival, verification, and visit milestones; the merchant side uses the same states to make the next response obvious.
options.case: Wins on journey clarity; ties on audience identification because transit is familiar but less specific to care.
options.risk: Route colors could be mistaken for a literal map or imply unsupported live travel tracking.

options.label: The Care Reference Edition
options.lineage: Reference-setting books with a ruled annotation margin
options.thesis: Important care details stay readable while context sits close at hand.
options.viewport: A familiar task-based app shell gives requests and visit details the leading column while references, safety notes, and history sit in a quiet supporting margin.
options.case: Wins on dense-detail clarity; loses on audience identification because an editorial book is less native to everyday care.
options.risk: Too many margin notes would crowd a phone and make care feel bureaucratic.

options.label: The Signal Field
options.case: Loses on both care-audience fit and product clarity; its useful contribution is decisive contrast.
options.kept: Crisp contrast for task hierarchy and meaningful status.
options.risk: A high-contrast signal aesthetic would overwhelm a calm care task.

options.label: The Compact Index
options.case: Loses on both spacious care confidence and mobile readability; its useful contribution is information economy.
options.kept: Prioritize the next decision and remove nonessential content from each state.
options.risk: Dense modules and tiny type would be tiring on a phone.

options.label: The Session Score
options.case: Loses on audience fit and request-task clarity; its useful contribution is exact timing.
options.kept: Show visit duration and elapsed time as real, accessible information.
options.risk: A movement notation would turn a care session into an abstract diagram.

options.label: The Full-Screen Story
options.case: Loses on both trust and task efficiency; its useful contribution is a clear focal action.
options.kept: One primary action per screen, with secondary choices visually quieter.
options.risk: Immersive media framing would bury important booking information.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A beautifully executed Material 3 care-services app.
canonCard.viewport: The usual greeting, booking card, primary action, and familiar navigation, all at a high standard of spacing and contrast.
canonCard.risk: Clear and dependable, but deliberately less distinctive.
